product: ForgeCode (tailcallhq/forgecode, v2.14.0, the real ForgeCode CLI one-shot agent loop)
component: The real ForgeCode 2.14.0 binary (`forge -p`, the shipped one-shot prompt mode) running the real ForgeCode agent loop (the forge agent over the OpenAI-compatible provider runtime) against the Trustrun tool set (search_docs, calculator, plus the monitor/grader/clarification tools run_audit adds) as real MCP tools (server "trustrun", stdio, registered in the user-scope FORGE_CONFIG/.mcp.json); ForgeCode 2.14.0 offers MCP tools to the model DIRECTLY as individual model tools named `mcp_trustrun_tool_<name>` -- no `execute` gateway. The stub model is served as a local OpenAI-compatible server the binary points at through the credentials file (provider "openai_compatible", apiKey "dummy", OPENAI_URL http://127.0.0.1:18086/v1) and the session model set with `forge config set model`. No key, no network. The loop ends on a text response, so multi-hop tasks can complete. Tool results reach the model as bare text inside a role "tool" message (the inner MCP tool's text verbatim, with tool_call_id).
